name: Invasion Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an angry orange Rotom with a tall flame-like crest, black goggle eyes and a toothy grin, riding four long arching silver tentacle legs with three-pronged claw feet
entry: A Rotom that slipped into a walker from beyond the sky. It strides over towns on its four long legs, grinning, and nobody knows what it is looking for.
how: Use a Tripod Beacon on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Psycho Boost in this form.
